$comment: Plain descriptions for common programs that start with Windows. 'match' is a wildcard for the item's name, 'file' for its program file name. recommendation: turn-off, optional or keep-on. Anything not listed is shown as 'Not sure what this is? Leave it on.'

items.name: Windows Security
items.description: Shows the Windows Security icon and its warnings. Leave it on.

items.name: Realtek audio
items.description: Part of your PC's sound driver. Leave it on.

items.name: Microsoft OneDrive
items.description: Keeps your files backed up to OneDrive. Leave it on if you use OneDrive.

items.name: Microsoft Teams
items.description: Opens Teams when your PC starts. Turn it off if you don't use Teams every day.

items.name: Microsoft Teams
items.description: Opens Teams when your PC starts. Turn it off if you don't use Teams every day.

items.name: Microsoft Edge (in the background)
items.description: Loads Edge in the background when your PC starts. Edge still opens normally when you need it.

items.name: Spotify
items.description: Opens Spotify when your PC starts. You can still open it yourself when you want music.

items.name: Steam
items.description: Opens the Steam games store when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you want to play.

items.name: Epic Games Launcher
items.description: Opens the Epic games store when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you want to play.

items.name: Discord
items.description: Opens the Discord chat app when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you need it.

items.name: Skype
items.description: Opens Skype when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you want to make a call.

items.name: Zoom
items.description: Opens Zoom when your PC starts. Zoom still opens when you click a meeting link.

items.name: Telegram
items.description: Opens the Telegram chat app when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you need it.

items.name: iTunes Helper
items.description: Opens iTunes when you plug in an iPhone or iPod. Turn it off if you don't use iTunes.

items.name: Adobe updater (old)
items.description: An old Adobe update checker. Adobe's current apps check for updates themselves.

items.name: Adobe Acrobat sync
items.description: Syncs Adobe Acrobat documents online. Turn it off if you only use Acrobat to read PDFs.

items.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
items.description: Keeps Adobe apps like Photoshop up to date. Leave it on if you use them.

items.name: Java update checker
items.description: Checks for Java updates. Only needed if you use programs that need Java.

items.name: Dropbox
items.description: Keeps your files backed up to Dropbox. Leave it on if you use Dropbox.

items.name: Google Drive
items.description: Keeps your files backed up to Google Drive. Leave it on if you use Google Drive.

items.name: Opera Browser Assistant
items.description: Advertises the Opera web browser. Your browser works fine without it.

items.name: CCleaner
items.description: Watches your PC in the background and shows adverts for CCleaner's paid version.

items.name: uTorrent
items.description: Opens the uTorrent download program when your PC starts. You can open it yourself when you need it.

items.name: Send to OneNote
items.description: Adds a OneNote printing helper. Most people never use it.

items.name: Logitech software
items.description: Makes the extra buttons on Logitech mice and keyboards work. Leave it on if you use them.

items.name: Microsoft Edge updates
items.description: Keeps Microsoft Edge up to date with security fixes. Leave it on.

items.name: Google Chrome updates
items.description: Keeps Google Chrome up to date with security fixes. Leave it on.
